name: Circle of the Sea (Druid Subclass - 2024)
description: Druids of the Circle of the Sea command the power of tides and storms, often fighting at close range with elemental fury.
source: RPGBOT 2024 Circle of the Sea Druid Subclass Guide (PHB)
domain_spells_note: Circle of the Sea Spells are always prepared and do not count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

3.name: Circle of the Sea Spells (Level 3)
3.description: Always have Ray of Frost (cantrip), Create or Destroy Water, Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Shatter prepared.

3.name: Wrath of the Sea
3.description: Bonus Action to activate a 10-foot radius stormy aura for 10 min. Once per turn when you hit a creature in aura with an attack or it fails a save vs your spell, deal extra 1d8 cold damage and push 10ft (Con save vs spell DC to halve/negate push).

5.name: Circle of the Sea Spells (Level 5)
5.description: Always have Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing prepared.

6.name: Aquatic Affinity
6.description: Wrath of the Sea radius increases to 30 feet. Gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed.

7.name: Circle of the Sea Spells (Level 7)
7.description: Always have Control Water, Ice Storm prepared.

9.name: Circle of the Sea Spells (Level 9)
9.description: Always have Cone of Cold, Conjure Elemental prepared.

10.name: Stormborn
10.description: While Wrath of the Sea is active, gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and resistance to cold, lightning, and thunder damage.

14.name: Oceanic Gift
14.description: As an action, expend Wild Shape use to grant benefits of Wrath of the Sea and Stormborn to one willing creature touched for 1 hour.
